description:
Business Development Manager, Navy

Location: Remote, US (with approximately 30% travel supporting customer engagements, demonstrations, fleet exercises, and industry events)
Clearance Requirement: U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

About NODA

NODA is a Veteran-owned, venture-backed technology company that is transforming how unmanned systems collaborate in complex, mission-critical environments. We are developing next-generation solutions that enable the autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous unmanned systems across air, sea, land, and space with vital applications in the defense, intelligence, and commercial sectors.

Our Business Development team plays a critical role in shaping how autonomous systems are adopted across the defense enterprise, influencing requirements before they are written, shaping acquisition strategies before they are released, and accelerating the transition of next-generation autonomy capabilities from concept to operational deployment.

Joining NODA means working on meaningful technology that pushes the boundaries of autonomy alongside a team that thrives on innovation, rapid iteration, and collaboration.

The Role

As our Business Development Manager for the Navy, you’ll lead NODA’s growth across the U.S. Navy and the wider naval enterprise. This is not an account management role. This is a builder’s role.

You’ll identify emerging maritime mission needs, establish trusted relationships across the Navy’s fleet, acquisition, and innovation communities, influence acquisition strategies, and lead opportunities from initial engagement through contract award. You’ll work directly with fleet operators, Program Executive Offices, Systems Commands, warfare centers, prime contractors, and industry partners to position NODA where our technology creates operational advantage across surface, undersea, and air domains.

Success in this role requires initiative, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and opportunities are often created rather than assigned. You’ll be equally comfortable discussing operational challenges with sailors and fleet staff, technical integration with engineers, and acquisition strategy with senior Navy leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute NODA’s business development strategy across the Navy, including fleet commands, Program Executive Offices, Systems Commands, and naval innovation organizations

  • Build trusted relationships with fleet operators, unmanned task forces, acquisition professionals, contracting officers, Naval Warfare Centers, laboratories, prime contractors, and senior Navy stakeholders

  • Identify, qualify, shape, and capture strategic opportunities across unmanned surface, undersea, and air systems, from early customer engagement through proposal, negotiation, award, and transition to execution

  • Develop and maintain a healthy multi-quarter pipeline while delivering accurate forecasting, opportunity qualification, and disciplined CRM management

  • Lead capture planning including customer engagement strategy, competitive assessments, solution shaping, teaming strategies, pricing support, win themes, proposal development, bid/no-bid recommendations, and executive gate reviews

  • Influence future Navy requirements through regular engagement with fleet operators, requirements sponsors, and program offices

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Mission Operations, Contracts, and Executive Leadership to align Navy priorities with NODA’s product roadmap and growth strategy

  • Navigate FAR-based contracts, OTAs, CSOs, SBIR/STTR, IDIQs, NavalX, DIU, and other rapid acquisition mechanisms

  • Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with naval prime contractors, shipbuilders, systems integrators, unmanned vehicle manufacturers, academia, and mission partners

  • Represent NODA at demonstrations, fleet experimentation events, exercises, and industry events including Sea-Air-Space, WEST, the Surface Navy Association National Symposium, and AUVSI XPONENTIAL

  • Monitor Navy priorities, unmanned systems strategy, funding, competitive activity, and capability gaps to inform executive decision-making

  • Develop executive briefings, capability presentations, white papers, and strategic communications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of business development, capture management, military, government, or related DoD experience, with significant focus on the Navy

  • Demonstrated success winning new business from customer engagement through contract award

  • Strong understanding of the Navy enterprise, including fleet, acquisition, and requirements organizations, budget cycles, and procurement processes

  • Experience with FAR-based contracting and non-traditional acquisition pathways including OTAs, CSOs, SBIR/STTR, IDIQs, and rapid acquisition efforts

  • Established relationships across the Navy’s fleet, acquisition, and innovation communities

  • Ability to engage credibly in technical discussions involving autonomy, AI-enabled software, robotics, interoperability, and unmanned maritime systems

  • Experience developing account strategies, capture plans, competitive positioning, and win strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of military, government, and industry experience

  • Ability to travel approximately 30%

  • Due to the nature of the position, U.S. citizenship is required due to ITAR regulations, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior service in the U.S. Navy or extensive experience supporting Navy organizations

  • Existing relationships across NAVSEA, NAVAIR, NAVWAR, ONR, PEO Unmanned and Small Combatants, Naval Warfare Centers, NavalX, DIU, or fleet unmanned units

  • Experience supporting unmanned surface, undersea, or air vehicles (USV, UUV, UAS), ISR, C5ISR, maritime autonomy, or adjacent defense technologies

  • Experience supporting fleet experimentation, exercises, or technology transition efforts

  • Experience with the U.S. Marine Corps or allied navies

  • Experience working within a venture-backed or high-growth defense technology company

  • Active Top Secret or TS/SCI security clearance

Skills & Attributes

  • Strategic thinker who connects customer challenges with business growth and product strategy

  • Exceptional relationship builder with strong executive presence across government, industry, and the fleet

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity tracking

  • Collaborative partner across Engineering, Product, Operations, Contracts, and Leadership

  • Mission-first mindset with a passion for delivering operational advantage to the warfighter

  • Builder mentality with the initiative to create opportunities and shape markets rather than wait for them

  • Technically curious, with the ability to translate complex autonomy and AI concepts into mission value

  • Resilient, adaptable, accountable, and comfortable operating independently in ambiguous startup environments

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

  • We offer premium medical, dental, and vision coverage with zero paycheck premiums for you and your family

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals + Company match

  • Equity grants for new hires

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 11 Paid holidays

  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in November, & December.

  • Generous Parental Leave

  • Military Leave for annual training or service requirements

  • FSA

  • DCFSA

  • HSA

  • Professional Development Opportunities

  • Access to One Medical

  • Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well.

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.
